shared_review.style: 通过：灰蓝无缝棚拍背景、柔和光线、自然地面阴影，无文字编号箭头。

shared_review.anatomy: 通过：头躯干与四肢比例自然，关节连接连续，双手与双鞋完整，支撑接触可辨。

frames.target_pose: 起线前双脚静止站稳、朝终线
frames.review: 两脚并列贴地、未迈步；起线位于鞋尖前方，终线及完整通路可见，身体面向右侧终线。

attempts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one raw photographic rehabilitation demonstration frame, sequence 005 E-LOW-017 step 01, static start of a four-metre usual-pace walking test.
Input images: reference-01.png, reference-02.png and reference-03.png are the identity, clothing, face, proportions, ponytail, soft studio lighting and gray-blue seamless studio appearance references. The old 005 photograph is only a full-body clothing and white shoe reference; do NOT copy its short marker distance or walking pose.
Primary request: Make one highly realistic wide landscape studio photograph, approximately 2:1 width to height, of the SAME East Asian adult woman with black low ponytail, fitted plain white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal gray full-length trousers and the SAME simple white flat lace-up sneakers as the fourth reference. This is the stationary START frame, she is absolutely not taking a step.
Scene/backdrop: spacious clean pale gray-blue seamless studio, continuous matte gray-blue level floor, soft diffuse studio light and naturally soft grounded shadows. No other person and no furniture. A single unobstructed straight left-to-right walking route has only TWO short dark gray tape strips crossing it: one start strip on the left, one finish strip farther to the right. The start-to-finish distance is physically four metres: roughly 2.4 times the woman's standing head-to-floor height. Do not compress this to one stride. Tape strip width about 3 cm and length about 60 cm, both identical, clearly visible.
Composition/framing: lock one fixed camera position, broad nearly lateral side view with a very slight three-quarter angle allowing both shoes to be distinguished. The horizontal route lies across the lower portion of this wide frame. Camera never follows the woman. Entire 4 m route, both tape strips, full woman from crown to complete shoes, and an extra 1 m clear floor AFTER the finish strip remain visible. Use realistic normal-lens perspective rather than fisheye. Standing woman on LEFT near the start, start strip approximately 17 percent of picture width, finish approximately 74 percent, leave continuing space to the right. The woman should be only about 45–50 percent of image height so the real four-metre route can fit, but facial identity should remain recognizable. Stable ample clearance around her head and feet.
Subject pose: woman stands completely still at the start strip, both whole feet planted parallel next to each other, toes immediately behind and not past the start strip. Feet hip width, knees naturally straight but not locked, body erect, arms resting naturally down at sides, face and chest oriented RIGHT toward the finish line, eyes looking ahead along the route. No split stance, no raised heel, no stride or forward lean.
Constraints: exactly one woman and one clear posture, same identity and age impression as references, natural connected anatomy and body proportions, complete head/hands/feet, matte plain clothing and white flat sneakers, both physical tape markers visible and widely separated, no graphic overlays. Every subsequent image will keep this exact floor, tape positions, camera, focal length, framing, illumination, outfit and scale.
Avoid: any text, numerals, labels, ruler, measuring tape, arrow, symbol, watermark, border, collage, ghosted figure, duplicate person, running, turning, bent lunge, exaggerated motion, cropped body, distorted hands or limbs.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: scientific-educational photographic rehabilitation demonstration, 005 E-LOW-017 step 02, usual-pace walking BETWEEN the two lines.
Image 1 is the edit target and exact scene/camera/identity reference. Make the next frame in the SAME scene by changing ONLY the single woman's horizontal location, body pose and corresponding grounded shadow.
Move the same woman from the left start strip to exactly halfway between the two floor tape strips, near horizontal centre of the frame. She faces RIGHT and walks normally along the straight left-to-right route, looking ahead, no turning and no running. Show one natural gait instant: left foot flat supporting on the floor under/slightly behind the pelvis, right leg stepping forward with mild knee flexion and heel just above the floor. Natural small reciprocal arm swing, left arm a little forward and right arm a little backward, relaxed hands, nearly upright torso. Natural small usual-walking step, not a long lunge. No frozen standing stance.
LOCK these invariants: entire 1774x887 landscape composition; exact two dark gray tape strips at the SAME original coordinates and angles (start left, finish right); no additional floor marks; same gray-blue seamless studio floor/backdrop, soft illumination and shadows; same camera viewpoint and normal lens look; same low black ponytail, East Asian face and age impression, white plain T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, flat white lace-up sneakers; same height and body scale as target (about 440 pixels head-to-floor, about 49 percent image height). Body may not grow or shrink as she moves. Keep the floor contact height aligned to the start-frame route. Both whole feet and full head/hands visible, subject wholly BETWEEN start and finish, route and spare floor beyond finish retained.
No duplicate or ghost woman at the old position. No text, numerals, arrows, labels, watermarks, collage, new props, measuring tape, dramatic motion or graphic overlays. Preserve original background and floor geometry as closely as possible.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: scientific-educational photographic rehabilitation demonstration, 005 E-LOW-017 step 03, CONTINUE WALKING AFTER crossing the four-metre finish line.
Image 1 is the edit target, exact studio scene and stationary-camera reference. Image 2 is the immediately previous walking frame, same woman/scale/outfit/gait reference.
Make the final frame by changing ONLY the single woman's horizontal position, natural gait pose and corresponding grounded shadow. Remove her from the left start. Put her on the FAR RIGHT AFTER the existing RIGHT floor tape strip, facing RIGHT, continuing naturally forward. Her entire body and BOTH shoes must now be visibly beyond the finish strip.
